newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates soar to close at 28 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates soar to close at 28 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates soared on Friday as at least one large institution ran short of funds, dealers said.
Rates began at 20.5 percent then rose to close at 28 percent.
"It was a very surprising session," said Balazs Benczedi of West LB Hungaria. "One large bank seems to have found itself under-reserved and sudeenly needed money."
The rise bucked a recent trend which saw rates fall this week amid market liquidity. They had been expected to keep their low level until the end of the reserve period on Friday.
